evidence.title: Egoist Machines Founder Launch
evidence.excerpt: Every AI app is trying to learn who you are. We think you should own the answer. Egoist Machines is building AI Passport, the user-owned context and memory layer for consumer AI. The way things work right now, ChatGPT, Claude, health apps, wearables, shopping platforms, travel accounts, and financial tools each hold a different, incomplete model of the same person. Users repeatedly explain themselves while their personal data remains trapped across disconnected platforms. AI Passport gives…
